note: Four files were supplied for the five-stage travel sequence. The existing ready idle is reused before attack and after standing up. Source animation data is retargeted offline; meshes and FBX source files are not distributed in the app.

normalization.names: mixamorig9 bone names canonicalized to mixamorig, including all 30 finger joints.
normalization.rotations: Local FBX rotations are converted using parent rest world rotation * local animation rotation * inverse bone rest world rotation into the identity-rest VRM basis.
normalization.position: Hips converted from the source rig height to the runtime reference rig height. Absolute vertical motion is preserved; each clip horizontal endpoint displacement is removed while keeping authored hip sway.
normalization.interpolation: Original authored key times and quaternion spherical interpolation; reduced to <=0.25 degrees rotation and <=0.1 cm position error, checked using the runtime LCP1 decoder at source keys and 120 Hz.
